name: Ana Beauty Studio
address: 9509 W Flagler St, Suite 03, Miami, FL 33174 (inside Beauty Square / My Suite @ Beauty Square)
language_detection_notes: Setmore booking page defaults to lang=es and title 'Reserva ahora'; the two organic IG captions recovered ('Sin filtro', 'Cejas y pestañas on point') are both Spanish; owner is Venezuelan. Spanish set as primary language, English toggle included.
own_domain_note: anabeautystudio.com is listed on the Setmore page as their website but is now a dead/parked domain for sale via GoDaddy (curl confirms redirect to forsale.godaddy.com). Verified 2026-07-21. The demo site itself does not reference this dead domain; it may be used as an honest outreach angle ('your old domain expired') in outreach copy only, not on the site.
services: Basic and advanced eyelash extension training (lash artist training)
prices_note: No verifiable prices found anywhere (Setmore booking page has no visible menu without login/JS session, Fresha listing explicitly says 'not currently affiliated with Fresha' and shows only a generic Makeup Service placeholder with a different phone number, Yelp blocks scraping (403), IG captions have no prices). Site shows service names only, no invented numbers, per hard rule.
reviews_note: No independently verifiable star rating or review count. Owner's own IG story screenshot (discarded photo, not used on site) showed a Google listing card reading '5.0 (21)', but this is a single unverified secondary source (a screenshot within their own marketing, not a direct fetch of Google/Yelp). A separate web search aggregation surfaced a contradictory and implausible '358 reviews' figure with no primary source, clearly unreliable. Yelp page (yelp.com/biz/ana-beauty-studio-miami) exists but returned HTTP 403 to both curl and WebFetch, so it could not be verified directly. Given no consistent, independently-checkable number, the hard 'no invented reviews' rule applies: used the sin-testimonios 'Por que Ana Beauty Studio' 3-card variant (derived from real services: phi-lashes fit, ombre/henna brows, lash artist training) instead of any rating/stars/testimonials.

photos.source: Instagram public profile @anabeautystudiomiami via scripts/ig_photos.py (Railway ig-photo-service, Playwright). 12 posts total on the profile (all dated Sep-Nov 2022; the account appears inactive since then). Ran again with start_index=12 and confirmed no additional posts exist.
